name: RINDAX CRM Agent — Outreach & Response Tracker
description: Fully autonomous CRM agent powered by Claude Sonnet 4.6. Fetches leads from Airtable, writes personalized outreach emails, sends via Gmail, tracks replies, and updates lead status automatically. Two agents run in parallel: Outreach Agent (9 AM daily) and Response Tracker (every 4 hours).

agents.name: CRM Outreach Agent
agents.description: Fetches New and Follow-Up Due leads from Airtable, extracts emails from mixed Contact Info field, deduplicates, then loops — sending a personalized Gmail and updating Airtable status to Contacted.

agents.name: CRM Response Tracker Agent
agents.description: Checks Gmail inbox for unread emails, matches senders against Contacted leads in Airtable, classifies intent (Replied / Meeting Booked / Not Interested), and updates Airtable automatically.

nodes.name: Fetch Leads from Airtable
nodes.notes: Fetches leads with Status = New, Follow Up Due, or Replied

nodes.name: Extract Email from Contact Info
nodes.notes: Regex extracts email from mixed Contact Info field (may contain phone, LinkedIn URL, and email together)

nodes.name: Filter: Has Email?
nodes.notes: Passes only leads where an email was successfully extracted

nodes.name: Remove Duplicate Emails
nodes.notes: Deduplicates leads by extracted email address to avoid sending duplicate emails

nodes.name: No Email — Auto Close Lead
nodes.notes: Auto-closes leads with no email found in Contact Info

value.Notes: Auto-closed: No email address found in Contact Info

nodes.name: Loop Over Leads
nodes.notes: Processes one lead at a time

nodes.name: CRM Outreach Agent (Claude)
nodes.notes: Claude Sonnet AI Agent — reads lead data, writes personalized email, sends via Gmail, updates Airtable

parameters.systemMessage: You are a diligent CRM automation agent for RINDAX, an AI automation agency. Always process ALL leads returned. Never skip a lead. Write personalized outreach emails based on the company name, industry, and recommended service. After sending an email, always update Airtable immediately before moving to the next lead.

nodes.name: Send Email via Gmail
nodes.notes: AI-controlled Gmail tool. Claude decides recipient, subject, and body.

nodes.name: Update Lead Status in Airtable
nodes.notes: AI-controlled Airtable tool. Updates Status, Last Contacted, Follow Up Date, Notes.

nodes.name: CRM Response Tracker Agent (Claude)
nodes.notes: Claude Sonnet AI Agent — checks Gmail inbox, matches replies to Airtable leads, classifies intent, updates status

parameters.systemMessage: You are a precise CRM tracking agent. Check Gmail inbox for unread emails. Match each email sender to a lead in Airtable by email address. Classify the reply intent: Replied, Meeting Booked, Not Interested, or Needs More Info. Always update Airtable after every classification.
tools: Update Lead Reply Status in Airtable

nodes.name: Check Gmail Inbox for Replies
nodes.notes: Fetches all unread emails from inbox (excluding sent)

nodes.name: Fetch Contacted Leads from Airtable
nodes.notes: Fetches all leads with Status = Contacted for reply matching

nodes.name: Update Lead Reply Status in Airtable
nodes.notes: Updates lead with reply classification: Replied / Meeting Booked / Not Interested / Contacted
